hypothesis.h0: Holding a stable exact base until candidate handoff (S) does not lower wall-clock time to Mission satisfaction against periodic rebasing onto the moving accepted frontier (R).
hypothesis.h1: S lowers median wall-clock time to Mission satisfaction by at least 15% relative to R in every stratification cell.

falsification: Snapshot isolation is retained as an architectural invariant only if S lowers median wall-clock to Mission satisfaction by at least 15% relative to R in every one of the four cells, with the 95% BCa interval on the paired Hodges-Lehmann shift excluding zero in the pooled analysis. If the threshold holds in some cells only, snapshot isolation is demoted from an invariant to a scheduler policy conditioned on those cells. If it holds in no cell, R is adopted and the stable-exact-base requirement is removed. S worse than R in any cell is filed as a defect before any adoption decision.

conditions.description: stable exact base until candidate handoff
periodically rebase the worker onto the moving accepted frontier

population.sampling: paired on the workload item within each cell; conditions in randomized order

strata.boundary: <= 2 frontier admissions per hour on the base frontier
> 2 frontier admissions per hour on the base frontier

effect_size.measure: paired Hodges-Lehmann shift, expressed as a relative reduction versus R
effect_size.unit: relative reduction, required in every one of the four cells

analysis_plan.uncertainty: BCa bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, resampling seed recorded

exclusion_rule: A trial is excluded when the harness crashes before the first dispatch, when the model endpoint returns a transport error on more than 10% of the calls in that trial, or when the workload item's fixture repository fails its own pre-flight test. Excluded trials are retained with their reason and counted in the report. The rule is applied by script before the primary metric is inspected and never by judgement.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: cell assignment computed after the run; the duration and churn bins are fixed in this protocol and assigned from the fixture, not from the outcome
frontier churn generated by the harness rather than by real concurrent work
